scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The gate has not been forced.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: You can stop looking at me when you say that.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: I am not doubting you. I am doubting the route we assumed he used.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: There was a delivery worker here yesterday. His wife keeps calling him.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We can establish where he was without blaming him for being nearby.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
